assumptions.reward_only_sensitivity: Set multiplier to 1 to represent no incremental game value; identical rules and rewards, later state may diverge after responses.
assumptions.fixed_dairy: Fixed safe dairy category; real familiarity/stock/risk/economics filters; outcome model has no learned category response.
assumptions.cpa_break_even: Conditional sensitivity with visits, subsidy and sponsored events held fixed; not an optimized auction bid.
assumptions.funding_accounting: Declared challenge CPA and subsidy collected once; explicit [0,1] multipliers model nonpayment, not additional revenue.
assumptions.conservative_net: Four-week cash net minus max(0, ending coupon liability - opening coupon liability); opening external/seeded obligations are not subtracted twice.
limitations: no modelled exchange or habit after incentives
no global SKU stock or advertiser campaign budget depletion
positive policy chosen after earlier synthetic exploration, not a held-out profit test
